verdict.rationale: Weaviate is a vector database, and a buyer could fairly ask whether it ships background automations such as scheduled or triggered agent jobs, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only on-demand features: the Query Agent runs agentic search when called. The claim that 'agents can leverage semantic insights to make decisions or trigger actions' describes external agents using Weaviate as a backend, which is a developer building block rather than a first-party automation feature. Backups and autoTenantCreation are adjacent features with no documented recurring schedule or autonomous background execution.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
